name: Luke
bio: Luke, a physician and one of Paul's companions, was called by him "the beloved physician" when sending greetings in his letter to the Colossians; he was present with Paul through his later travels and imprisonments. Tradition credits Luke as the author of the Gospel of Luke and the book of Acts, both of which he wrote as a careful historian though he does not name himself in either (Colossians 4:14). Near the end of his life, Paul noted that only Luke remained with him (2 Timothy 4:11).
